Text.Text: Their commander is dead, and the forged orders no longer have an army behind them. You kept your judgment while they tried to break it. I will record that you passed. I can now complete your Eclipse of Resolve instruction.

No. Your command of the Force is not yet sufficient. The Depths would test your fear, and you would fail before you understood the question. Train further. Return when the Force answers you without hesitation.

The Umbral Raiders presented forged excavation orders for the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. By the time the forgery was found, they had seized the tombs below the Sith Crypt and turned the old defenses on the survey crews. I am tasked with correcting the error. Put down six Umbral Raider Scouts and recover the Eclipse of Resolve Crypt Trial Tablet. Their false claim begins with it.
Take this key. It opens the sealed passage at the north end of the Sith Crypt on Korriban. Six scouts, one tablet. They will try to frighten you first. Note it, and proceed.

Eclipse of Resolve is the discipline of acting through fear without surrendering judgment. These raiders use intimidation to hide weak positions. Fear is information. Learn to read it, then look past it.

Korriban. From the starport, go east into the Wastelands North and cross to the elevator on the north-east side of the wastes. It takes you down into the Sith Crypt; the sealed passage at the crypt's north end opens into the Depths. I remain here because their cargo moves through this district. I am tracing who bought the forged orders, and who is buying what they dig up.

Independent relic thieves and hired guns, neither academy students nor an authorized crew. Rodian scouts and gunhands make up most of them. Their captain and commander are Twi'lek, and they wear stolen officers' armor to make the forged orders look real. They attack anyone who questions their authority.
Six Umbral Raider Scouts and the trial tablet. The passage is at the north end of the Sith Crypt on Korriban. Proceed.
You have the Eclipse of Resolve Crypt Trial Tablet. Let me see it.
It lists the tombs they claim under the forged orders. Several were never opened before. Their adepts have moved deeper with the relics. Your next assignment will follow.

The scouts were the outer layer. Their adepts carry the Eclipse of Resolve Ritual Focus Shard and use it to cast dread over anyone who approaches. Put down five Umbral Raider Adepts and recover the shard.
Five Umbral Raider Adepts and the focus shard. When the dread comes, do not mistake it for your own.
It was taken from a sealed relic chamber, and it amplifies fear. The adepts use it to drive the survey crews out of positions they could have held. Recovering it removes their best weapon.
Not in one place. The adepts patrol the Depths in small groups, and one of them carries the shard. Search the passages methodically.
They project fear before they strike, then attack whoever hesitates. Do not hesitate. Choose one, finish it, and move to the next. Keep your companions where you can see them.
Five Umbral Raider Adepts and the shard, in the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. The forged orders are still in circulation.
You brought the Eclipse of Resolve Ritual Focus Shard. Hand it over.
The shard is secured. Their captain has been holding the dig together through fear alone. He is next.

Their captain, a Twi'lek listed as the Umbral Raider Captain, holds the trial altar in the north-west of the Depths. He broke the Eclipse of Resolve Splintered Tomb Sigil off a sealed tomb to prove their claim. Go to that altar and he will answer. Bring at least two allies, and recover the sigil.
Acceptable. The altar is in the north-west of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Defeat the captain and bring me the sigil. All three of you, preferably.

A Twi'lek mercenary who leads by intimidation and backs it with a blaster. He was placed at the altar to stop the survey crews from reaching the forced tomb. He is good. Do not let his reputation do his work for him.
It was broken off a sealed tomb entrance as proof of their claim. Its markings show which tomb they forced. It is also evidence of the forgery, which I need.
Because fear works best on the isolated. A lone fighter can be cornered and broken. Three can hold each other steady. That is the lesson, not a courtesy.
The captain still holds the altar in the north-west of the Depths. Two allies. Then the sigil.
You brought the Eclipse of Resolve Splintered Tomb Sigil. Present it.
Confirmed. This is the tomb named in their forged orders. With the captain gone, their saboteurs will try to bury what remains.

Four Rodians, recorded as Umbral Raider Saboteurs, are wrecking the remaining tomb seals so no one can prove what was taken. They carry the Eclipse of Resolve Keeper's Rite Token, the keepers' mark that opens the last vaults. Put down four Umbral Raider Saboteurs and recover the token.
Four Umbral Raider Saboteurs and the token. They range through the Depths. Take them one at a time.
Rodian demolition hands the raiders hired to break seals and collapse passages behind them. They are quick, and they know the tunnels. They are destroying evidence. Stop them.
The tomb keepers carried it. It opens the deepest vaults and marks whoever holds it as entitled to enter. The raiders have been using it to make their forgery look legitimate.
Do not let all four engage you at once. Choose your ground, keep your allies close, and watch the passages behind you. They know these tunnels better than you do.
Four Umbral Raider Saboteurs and the Keeper's Rite Token, in the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths.
You brought the Eclipse of Resolve Keeper's Rite Token. Present it.
The token is secured. Only their commander remains.

Their commander, a Twi'lek recorded as the Umbral Raider Commander, has withdrawn into the Final Ritual Chamber, through the door at the north end of the Depths. He signed the forged orders, and he is preparing the last shipment. Stop him. Bring at least two allies.
Go. The Final Ritual Chamber is through the north door of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. He will try to break your nerve before he breaks anything else.
The commander himself. He wrote the forgery, recruited the raiders, and holds the last relics. Break his hold there and the surviving crews can withdraw.
He is Force-trained, and he uses fear as a weapon. He will make you doubt your footing, your allies, and your purpose. None of it is real. Keep your judgment, cover one another, and press forward.
I finish tracing the forged orders through this district and close the matter. When you return, the recovered records will let us account for what they stole.
The Umbral Raider Commander is in the Final Ritual Chamber, at the north end of the Depths. Take your allies.
The Umbral Raider Commander is down. Report.

Their commander is dead, and the forged orders no longer have an army behind them. You kept your judgment while they tried to break it. I will record that you passed. I can now complete your Eclipse of Resolve instruction.

Cargo changes hands in this Shipping District every hour. Smuggler's Moon is where I can follow the buyers without making every visitor answer to the academy. Your allegiance doesn't clear the tombs; your work does. The Umbral Raiders remain in the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths on Korriban. Report back to me here.
Go over the first assignment.
I'll go down and bring back the tablet.
What does this discipline teach?
Where do I go, and why are you staying here?
Who or what will I be fighting?
I need to prepare first.
Here is the recovered tablet.
Go over the next objective.
I will recover the focus shard.
Why does the shard matter?
Where do they keep it?
How do they fight?
I need more time.
Here is the focus shard.
Go over the captain again.
I'll bring two allies and take the sigil.
Who is the captain?
Why recover the broken sigil?
Why bring a group?
I will gather my companions first.
The captain is dead. Here is the sigil.
Go over the four Saboteurs again.
I'll stop the four Saboteurs.
Who are these Saboteurs?
What does the token do?
How should we approach them?
I need to rest first.
Here is the recovered token.
Go over the final objective.
We will go in together.
What is waiting in the last chamber?
What makes the leader dangerous?
What happens after this?
My companions need to prepare.
The final target is down. We made it out.
Why are we meeting here, and where is the trial?
Back to the assignment.
